goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester auto-claimed a plot, watched cash grow, opened the SHOP and bought Dropper 2, Silver Ore and Speed 1. It also bought the Dropper 3, Cash x1.5 and Dropper 4 pads. It never walked to the TOP TYCOONS board (step 11 intended it, then it went elsewhere), and Dropper 2 was bought through the shop card rather than the green pad. The probe reported no server errors, but pad state and the shop looked inconsistent.

bugs.title: Bought pads still listed as available / unreachable (Dropper 3)
bugs.evidence: Dropper 3 was bought by step 7 (HUD 'Upgraded: Dropper 3', Slots 3). At steps 13 and 16 go_touch on UpgradePad_dropper3 returned 'never touched', and the touch list still showed 'Dropper 3 | $150' (step 16). Cash was about 1.1K to 2.4K, so a purchased pad appears to stay in the pad list with a price. This is confusing, and the playtester could not tell whether it was owned.

bugs.title: Gold Ore Buy button in SHOP did not fire
bugs.evidence: Step 18: clicking Card_tier_gold.State 'Buy' with Cash about 2.5K gave 'button did NOT fire'. Other Buy buttons (dropper2, silver, speed1) worked at steps 2, 4 and 7. Either the button is not clickable, or an unaffordable or locked card looks buyable with no feedback.

bugs.title: TotalEarned attribute seeded at about 1e12 while cash is tiny
bugs.evidence: Playtester flags at steps 6, 10 and 12: TotalEarned went from 1000000000176 to 1000000000200 and later 1000000001028 while Cash was 142 to 846. Rebirth was still denied (rebirth_denied=6). This is likely a debug or seed value, and it could distort the leaderboard or rebirth logic.

bugs.title: Rebirth button and altar give no visible panel or confirmation
bugs.evidence: REBIRTH $5000 was pressed at steps 3, 8 and 12, and the altar prompt was used at steps 5, 10 and 15. Each time only a 'Not ready' denial was recorded (rebirth_denied=6), with no panel or confirm dialog. UI coverage says the REBIRTH panel was never opened. A new player gets little guidance on why it fails.

bugs.title: SHOP panel stays open while walking and the pad list flickers
bugs.evidence: At step 10, the shop was still open after the playtester moved away (step 11 had to close it). The nearby pad lists in the observations changed between 'Next:' goals and touch lists (steps 7, 10, 14, 16), so the displayed purchase order is unclear to a new player.
